live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#730; borg-reborn-rs #1085, PR #1088). Two arms on track-p 1c071812: ctl (shipped: explore_breadth_first 1, the per-class explore_bfs_max_hp and explore_bfs_hp_per_level of the class files, explore_bfs_slack 0) and bfs0 (explore_breadth_first 0, C's depth-first order). Pilot as the gate, then the full tier (classes-1800 starts 901-1800, 900 per arm). Primary: deaths by 100,000 turns, exact McNemar by start (rescued = dead with bfs0 and alive with ctl); deaths at CL <= 2 and on DL1 apart. Progress cost, prespecified: starts reaching DL3, DL4 and DL5 (any outcome, exact McNemar by start), mean final CL and depth, per class; how long weak characters stay weak (first_turn_at_level, turns_at_level_depth, first_turn_at_max_hp of the cells, #718), for each class's threshold. Pilot evidence: per game the '# Flowing toward dark-bfs' style notes (the new method) against dark-1..5 and the games where it never acts (identical plays).
Tier pilot: classes-18, 100,000 turns, one binary, shipped settings plus each arm's overrides, borg-rs core, specimen track-p 1c071812. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; stalls and wall timeouts apart; identical plays per arm (a switch that plays the control's keys in most pairs was not exercised). Descriptive (RULES 14); whether it stays shipped on is a borg-reborn-rs decision.
